title: Crispy Air-Fried High-Protein Chicken Nuggets
summary: Chicken breast blended with an egg, garlic and spices, shaped into nuggets, coated in crushed cornflakes and air-fried until crisp. Makes about 12.

ingredients.note: He ran out and used a little fresh onion in the video

steps.text: Put the diced chicken breast in a blender or food processor with the egg, garlic cloves, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt and black pepper.
Blend into a thick mixture. Stop once it's combined; don't blitz it to a paste.
Crush the cornflakes into crumbs in a separate bowl.
Shape the mixture into small nuggets and press each one into the cornflakes until fully coated.
Give them a light spray of cooking spray.
Air fry at 200 °C (400 °F) for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden, crispy and cooked through.
Serve with your favourite dipping sauce. He uses ketchup.

nutrition.note: Based on 12 nuggets. The creator says the macros vary with the cornflakes and chicken used.

notes: A remake: the description credits @hunt4shredz. Louis rates it 9/10.
